p: is not stated in the holy Torah
regarding the day of Shemini Atzeres;
rather, it is included from the pasuk
to include the night of the last Yom Tov
And there too, in Parashas Re'eh,
לֹא נִזְכָּר יוֹם שְׁמִינִי עֲצֶרֶת כְּלוּם,
the day of Shemini Atzeres is not mentioned at all,
only "You shall make the festival of Sukkos for yourself
and "You shall rejoice in your festival" (ibid. 14).
For in truth the essential joy
from the joy of the festival of Sukkos.
And the essential joy of the festival of Sukkos
is not that a person should say,
in ease and joy on his own account,
from now on be of a happy heart.
that the essential joy should come
from humility and brokenness of heart,
the joy is acquired in the heart,
and as it says regarding the four species,
וּשְׂמַחְתֶּם לִפְנֵי ה׳ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם (וַיִּקְרָא כג, מ),
"And you shall rejoice before Hashem your God" (Vayikra 23:40);
and as we said in the allusion of the Gemara,
go out of the permanent dwelling
and dwell in a temporary dwelling" (Sukkah 2a):
that precisely this is the saying of the Torah,
all seven lights of the middos
by way of the holiness of the Torah,
by one's going out of the permanent dwelling
and as it says in the Tanchuma,
does not merit words of Torah.
And precisely through this he merits
and as mentioned in Tanna Devei Eliyahu
"My joy is from within my fear."
And to this one may find an allusion
in the close of Perek HaYashen (Sukkah 29b),
which is the end of the laws of the sukkah:
"But the humble shall inherit the land
וְהִתְעַנְּגוּ עַל רוֹב שָׁלוֹם (תְּהִלִּים לז, יא),
"But to this one will I look:
to the poor and the broken in spirit."
And the joy of Shemini Atzeres
is also alluded to in the pasuk
וְיָסְפוּ עֲנָוִים בַּה׳ שִׂמְחָה (שָׁם כט, יט),
"And the humble shall increase their joy in Hashem" (ibid. 29:19);
for the joy of Shemini Atzeres
its being made an addition to the festival of Sukkos,
and as it says in the Midrash
"You have added to the nation, You are glorified" (Yeshayahu 26:15);
the addition of Hakadosh Baruch Hu
מְרוּבָּה עַל הָעִיקָּר וְכוּלֵּי (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה סא, ד);
וְהוֹסַפְתִּי עַל כָּל תְּהִלָּתֶךָ (תְּהִלִּים עא, יד).
and I will add to all Your praise" (Tehillim 71:14).
And regarding Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
and he built himself a house,
and for his livestock he made booths."
to be, in all his affairs,
that it should never slip away from him;
for this is the essence of the House of Hashem:
to shelter in Him, Yisbarach, permanently.
that is, for the generations to come,
although they will no longer be able
at any rate they will make booths:
that all the matters of this world
be for them like a temporary dwelling.
And this is like the allusion mentioned above,
and dwell in a temporary dwelling."
And in line with this allusion,
in the sukkah on Shemini Atzeres,
for the holiness has already been bound
into the inwardness of the heart,
so as to be called a house.
